'''Quirino O. Navarro''' (29 March 1936 – 19 December 1997) was a Filipino [[nuclear physics|nuclear physicist]] and [[chemist]] who studied [[isotope]]s of [[californium]], [[dysprosium]], and [[einsteinium]]. His work was published in two books and three volumes and even became useful for teaching students in the [[University of California]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.famousfilipino.com/content/view/73/118/|title=Quirino O. Navarro|access-date=September 25, 2013|archive-date=September 28, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130928014515/http://www.famousfilipino.com/content/view/73/118/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://researchforstudents.com/2011/04/filipino-scientist-pictures/quirino-o-navarro/|title=Quirino O. Navarro|access-date=September 25, 2013|archive-date=September 27, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130927121134/http://researchforstudents.com/2011/04/filipino-scientist-pictures/quirino-o-navarro/|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 1956 he graduated from the [[University of the Philippines]] with a bachelor's degree in [[chemistry]] and by 1962 he got his Ph.D. in [[nuclear chemistry]] from the University of California.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.scribd.com/doc/59401062/Filipino-Chemist|title=Jeff Cadimas|access-date=September 25, 2013}}</ref>

Navarro died on 19 December 1997, at the age of 57.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2012-03-28 |title=March 29, 1936: Quirino Navarro Born in Oriental Mindoro |url=https://kahimyang.com/kauswagan/articles/1046/today-in-philippine-history-march-29-1936-quirino-navarro-was-born-in-pinamalayan-oriental-mindoro |access-date=2025-08-16 |website=The Kahimyang Project |language=en}}</ref>
